intent: Merge the four open PRs to master in dependency order, record the board truthfully, close the AI Session recording gap with a contract rule, and resume the task queue.
summary: Merged PR #37 (1d3ccad), #38 (034b181), #39 (35b1e3d) cleanly, then rebased #36 onto master (option B: merge master into branch, no history rewrite) and merged it as b14abea. Every conflict was in regenerated vault files, so the rebase used -X ours and all real code survived. Fixed a stale local DB that was missing M8, after which the full pgTAP suite passed 9 files / 98 tests. Set PSI-065/071/072/080 to done in the board source, ran the write-mode obsidian sync (75 tasks, 47 sessions, 71 files), and added contract rule C-22 requiring every AI session to be rendered in the vault and committed. Pushed master at 8557b04.

changes.note: PSI-065, PSI-071, PSI-072, PSI-080 -> done with merged: PR references
new contract rule C-22 (AI Session recording) + Definition of Done checkbox
regenerated from the gateway so Hermes sessions carry C-22
write-mode sync: Board, Home, Agent Log, 47 session notes, task notes

decisions.decision: Option B for PR #36: merged master into the branch instead of force-pushing the rebase
decisions.reason: The rebase rewrote the remote branch, and the required --force-with-lease hit an approval gate that timed out. Merging master in is additive, needs no history rewrite, and the resulting conflicts were identical (all in generated vault files), so the outcome is the same without the destructive push.

decisions.decision: Resolved every vault conflict with -X ours rather than hand-editing 22 files
decisions.reason: obsidian-out/ is generated from docs/list-task-project.md and agent-history/, so hand-resolving would create files the next sync overwrites anyway. Taking master's copy and regenerating the vault after the merge produces the correct output from the real source.

decisions.decision: Added C-22 to the gateway rather than only to AGENTS.md
decisions.reason: C-19 puts the gateway at the top of the precedence list, and .hermes.md is generated from it, so a rule written there reaches both agent harnesses in context. The AGENTS.md edit is a protected file and needs the operator, so the gateway is also the only place I can land this unilaterally.

decisions.decision: Recorded the recording gap as a contract rule instead of a note in HANDOFF
decisions.reason: The failure was not that I forgot to sync, it was that --check satisfies the old wording while rendering nothing, so the session looked recorded and was not. C-22 names the write-mode command and requires the generated note in the commit, which makes the gap detectable rather than silent.

verification.manual: Merged #37/#38/#39 through GitHub, then rebased #36: after `git rebase -X ours 35b1e3d` the branch diff still carried supabase/functions/google-calendar/{index,mapper,sync.test}.ts, _shared/google.ts and the obsidian-sync completion-stamp fix, and `git grep` found no conflict markers in scripts/, supabase/functions/ or supabase/tests/. Caught a red suite before pushing: agent_layer.test.sql failed 9/17 because the local DB was missing M8. `supabase db reset` applied M6..M9 cleanly and `supabase test db` then passed 9 files / 98 tests. Frontend: tsc --noEmit clean, oxlint 0 warnings 0 errors on 292 files, bun test 13/13, bun run build ok. PR #36 pushed with a normal push (914334d..b628286) and merged as b14abea — no force needed. Write-mode sync reported 75 tasks, 47 sessions, 71 files updated, and obsidian-out/history/ now holds the notes for PSI-065/071/072/080. bun run agent:check ok, agent:context reports .hermes.md current with C-22 present. Skipped: Jev acceptance (no user-facing change this session) and ecc-agentshield scan (agent config not touched).

human_review.reason: Merge and recording work only; no schema, RLS or credential change. The one item needing human action is AGENTS.md rule 5b, which is protected and left to the operator.
